item.title: Pope says Kentucky was able to “Dig In” for win over Indiana
item.description: LEXINGTON, Ky. (ABC 36 NEWS NOW) – The Kentucky men’s basketball team is fresh off a win over rival Indiana. This was the Wildcats’ first Quad 1 win of the season.
